newsitem.title: USA: Geneva Steel expects Q4 EPS $0.05 to $0.09.
newsitem.headline: Geneva Steel expects Q4 EPS $0.05 to $0.09.

text.p: Geneva Steel Co said Wednesday it expects net income for the fourth quarter ended September 30 of between $3 million and $3.5 million, or about $0.05 to $0.09 per share.
The estimates include dividends on preferred stock.
In last year's fourth quarter the company reported net income of $3.77 million, or $0.11 per share, on revenues of $168.9 million.
Operating income for the quarter is expected to be $14.8-$15.7 million, or $25 to $27 per ton of steel, it said.
"Our fourth quarter results should be better than the average of the analysts' estimates," Chairman and Chief Executive Joseph Cannon said in a statement.
Cannon said earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization will be about $25 million.
The company did not disclose the analysts' estimates on which it was basing its prediction.
According to First Call, analysts' consensus estimate is a loss for the quarter of $0.02 per share.
The company said later Wednesday that analysts' estimates ranged from a profit of $0.10 per share to a loss of $0.23 per share with a consensus estimate of a loss of $0.09 per share.
